subject: Charter handshake: FY28 Q3 OKR slate & clearance
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Charter handshake: FY28 Q3 OKR slate & clearance

Hi team,

Attached is the initial FY28 Q3 OKR charter I pulled together based on the owners' intake calls last week (OKR-charter-v1.xlsx). High level ask: please review and either sign off or send specific redlines by EOD Friday so we can lock the slate ahead of QBR materials.

Why this matters: we need a consistent, executable slate to share with Sales/CS for go-to-market alignment and to lock down measurement rubrics for the QBR. I tried to keep the top-line objectives tight and limit leading metrics to 3 per objective.

Key open items I flagged in the doc:
- Objective 1 (Serving runtime): moved latency SLO to p50/p95 split but left throughput as a complementary metric — need confirmation on SLO targets.
- Objective 2 (Dedication & Private): added a ramp plan for private installs but we need a commit threshold from sales.
- Objective 3 (Optimize): suggested a pilot with 3 customers for batching/caching ROI — need CS owners.

Specific asks:
1) Vivek — confirm the p95 latency target for the L1 serving objective (I put 120ms as a placeholder).
2) Laura — can you validate that the customer-facing language on the ramp plan is acceptable for our sales decks?
3) Rishi — flag any audit/finance gating items (licenses, procurement timeline) that would block go-live.

I scheduled a 30-min sync Thursday at 11am in case we need a quick walkthrough: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/charter-walk. If you can route signoffs in thread instead, that’s fine.

Attachments: OKR-charter-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR-prep-agenda.pdf (draft agenda).

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Product Manager, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Charter handshake: FY28 Q3 OKR slate & clearance

Thanks Camila — good work pulling this together. Quick notes after a skim (I made inline comments in OKR-charter-v1.xlsx):

- Objective 1: p95 120ms seems aggressive for the 512-token distribution we see in ML+SaaS (we're at ~160ms now on canary). Can we set p95 = 140ms and include a performance-risk mitigation step (quantization plan) in the owner column?
- Objective 2: for private installs, Sales is unlikely to commit to a revenue threshold without a trial-pilot. Recommend we add a pilot target (2 POCs) before the commit gating.
- Objective 3: agree on a 3-customer pilot but add measurement: tokens saved / 1000 tokens.

Operational ask: include a migration plan for any customers on our legacy endpoint to avoid double-billing confusion during rollouts.

I can take lead on the performance mitigation row and sync with Infra for kernel selection notes. If we set p95 to 140ms I can sign off; otherwise need more data.

Vivek
VP Product
Redwood Inference

- Objective 2: pilot gating (2 POCs) added; Sales to own POC commitments.

I'm aiming to consolidate final signoffs Friday noon to give PM and Marketing a day to prepare QBR slides. If you prefer a short walkthrough instead of back-and-forth, I'm available Thursday 11am as planned.
